text:
anya: Heads-up from a customer POC: the REST API supports a `batch_create_embeddings` route with idempotency via `Idempotency-Key` header, but the SDK doesn't expose that endpoint. Sampleapp falls back to looping single-item calls which creates duplicates and triggers rate limits.

remo: Oof. Is the SDK supposed to have batch embeddings? I thought we only had `embeddings.create` for single requests.

anya: REST: POST /v1/embeddings/batch accepts `items: [{id, text}]`, optional `dedupe` boolean, and `Idempotency-Key` header. SDK only has `client.embeddings.create({input})` and no way to pass Idempotency-Key or the `dedupe` flag.

sahil: That explains duplicate work. Two issues: missing endpoint in SDK and parameter name drift (`dedupe` vs `deduplicate` used in some docs). Also the server honors `Idempotency-Key` only if header present; body token ignored.

gil: Are we seeing auth/retry interactions too? If SDK retries at the per-item level without idempotency header the server treats them as new requests and rate-limits.

anya: Exactly. Sampleapp CI logs show repeated POSTs with different bodies and no `Idempotency-Key`. After a handful of retries we hit 429 then 401 because ephemeral creds rotated but retries still use cached token.

remo: Two-pronged fix: 1) add `batchCreate` surface to all SDKs mirroring REST, allowing `idempotencyKey` param that maps to `Idempotency-Key` header; 2) normalize param names: accept `dedupe` and `deduplicate` (both aliases) and map to server `dedupe`.

sahil: Also patch SDK retry middleware: for idempotent batch endpoints, include idempotency header across retries and don't rehydrate token from cache when server signals rotation header (`x-auth-rotate`). We should treat 401 during retried requests as a refresh-notify, attempt refresh once, then replay with same idempotency key.

gil: Add tests: unit tests for header propagation, e2e sampleapp CI test that hits a mocked server returning transient 500/429 then eventually 200 when idempotency header present. Also integration test that simulates `x-auth-rotate` mid-stream and assert SDK rotates and replays once.

anya: I'll open a small RFC in devdocs describing the batch endpoint shape and header behavior so SDK teams implement consistently. Also add a migration note for customers using per-item loops.

remo: Can you add a short repro script and failing logs to the ticket? That helps SDK maintainers replicate in CI quickly.

anya: Done: pasted repro and sampleapp failing log in the issue. Branch WIP: `feat/sdk-batch-embeddings-idempotency` in js/python/go SDKs. Link: https://git.internal/redwood/sdk-boards/issue/4472

devex-bot: CI for sampleapp/pull/418 reported repeated 500s on batch test. Failure: missing `Idempotency-Key` header in SDK request.

sahil: I'll take JS SDK patch to add `client.embeddings.batchCreate({items, dedupe?, idempotencyKey?})` and map `idempotencyKey` to header. Also add alias `deduplicate`.

gil: And I'll add the retry behavior patch for auth rotation and idempotent replay in the common HTTP middleware so other SDKs benefit.

remo: After patches, add a short note in quickstart explaining batch vs per-item embeddings, how to use idempotency keys, and the recommended retry semantics.

anya: Great. Marking this P1 for onboarding flows. Will follow up when the SDK PRs are green. :rocket:
